title: AirTrajectory coverage vectors mapped to Veklom EEE-Core review cases

target.purpose: review-only semantic mapping; not an EEE conformance claim

eee_alignment: issuer MUST produce exactly one terminal Envelope per execution attempt
valid included envelopes do not establish the completeness of a separately defined expected execution population
a denial without an Envelope is a spec violation
an explicit denied terminal Envelope is covered and must not be confused with omission

open_boundary: EEE-Core defines envelope integrity and sequence checks, but this review mapping intentionally leaves the authoritative source of the precommitted expected_execution_ids external until Veklom identifies the canonical CAPPO/authority object, if any.
non_claims: This file does not extend EEE-Core.
This file does not claim Veklom adoption or endorsement.
This file does not claim that previous_envelope_hash alone proves population completeness.
This file is a review artifact for issue #146.
